source_meaning: A direct report that an epidemic has broken out.

independent_English: The wind's died...

independent_English: Admiral, there are sharks! Watch out!

independent_English: Aah! Sharks! Watch out, Admiral!

independent_English: Admiral, those are sharks! Mind yourself now!

independent_English: Eek! Sharks! Watch out, Admiral!

independent_English: Whoa, sharks! Please be careful, Admiral!
